common_name: All the Rave Toad Lily (Long-Blooming Taiwan Toad Lily)

planting.note: Plant divisions in fall or early spring into humus-rich, evenly moist soil; this selection was collected in Taiwan and slowly matures into a broad flowering colony, so give it room to spread.

directions: Set divisions in fall or early spring in humus-rich soil that stays consistently moist, choosing a site with filtered light since this species tolerates more sun than most toad lilies. Arching, branched stems carry small white flowers flecked with purple from midsummer through frost, one of the longest bloom windows in the genus. Clumps expand gradually into a wide, loosely spreading colony over many years rather than forming a tight mound, so allow generous space or use it as a slow groundcover beneath high shade. Mulch with leaf litter and water during dry spells to keep the rhizomes from drying out between establishment and full colonization.
